description.value: Riverside Resort is a 7-acre resort on the Little Qualicum River near Parksville/Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, offering accommodations ranging from studio suites and standalone cabins to two-story condos and full hook-up RV sites with 30 and 50 amp service. The property features private riverfront access, a seasonal waterpark with pools and waterslides, an 18-hole mini-golf course, and an on-site R&R convenience store, all within a 5-minute walk of the ocean. RV sites are available year-round with extended stay options, making it a potential base for longer touring visits to the Oceanside region.

address.value: 3506 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2H4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information across multiple subpages. Laundry (coin facilities on-site) and Wi-Fi (free at all RV sites, included in extended stays) are explicitly confirmed by /rv-sites.html and /extended-stay.html. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site. The resort is clearly active, promoting a June 15, 2026 waterpark reopening and accepting bookings.
concerns: OSM tags this as tourism=hotel but the property is a multi-type resort with RV/camping sites, cabins, condos, and studios — the tag understates its nature.
OSM lists only the local phone (+1-250-752-9544); the website also lists a toll-free number (1-877-450-2211) not recorded in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active resort with diverse accommodation options including RV/camping sites; clearly operating with 2026 seasonal content. A useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Parksville/Qualicum Beach area.

Laundry.detail: Coin laundry facilities on-site for guests, open during regular office hours (/rv-sites.html)

wow_evidence: seasonal waterpark with pools and waterslides... private riverfront access... 5-minute walk of the ocean
